<entry id="M02826">

<sense>

<italic>light ship</italic>.</definition>

<definition />

<entry id="M02828">
<head-word>מָשׁוּךְ</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (מָשַׁךְ) 
<italic>one who has his prepuce drawn forward</italic> in order to disguise the sign of the covenant.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Sabb. XV (XVI), 9; Y. Yeb. VIII, 9
<sup>a</sup> top המושך (corr. acc.). Bab. ib. 72
<sup>b</sup> מ' דאורייתא that a 
<italic>mashukh</italic> must be circumcised again is a Biblical injunction; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. מְשׁוּכִין</plural-form>. Y. Yeb. l. c.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M02829">
<head-word>מְשׂוּכָּה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="U01157"> שָׂכַךְ = סָכַךְ)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>hedge, a hedged-in place, fold</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—
<plural-form>Pl. מְשׂוּכֹּות</plural-form>. Tosef. Ohol. XVIII, 12 (ed. Zuck., a. R. S. to Ohol. XVIII, 10 משיכות; ed. Zolk. משונית).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M02830">
<head-word>מְשׁוּלַּחַת</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (שָׁלַח) 
<italic>a divorced wife taken back after being married to another man</italic> (against the law, Deut. XXIV, 4).</definition>
<notes> Nidd. 69
<sup>b</sup> בת מ' the daughter of a woman illegitimately remarried.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M02831">
<head-word>מְשׁוּלָּשׁ</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="unknown"> מְשֻׁלָּשׁ; denom. of שָׁלשׁ)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> ; 
<plural-form>pl. מְשׁוּלָּשִׁים, מְשׁוּלָּשִׁין</plural-form></definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>developed to one third of the full growth</italic>.</definition>
<notes>. B. Mets. V, 4.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>group of three</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Shebi. I, 33
<sup>b</sup> חשבין מ' the quantity (of one cake of figs) for each three trees out of nine.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M02832">
<head-word>מְשׁוּמָּד</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (שָׁמַד) 
<italic>one deserving extinction</italic>; (interch. in edd. a. mss. with מוּמָר q. v.) 
<italic>open opponent to Jewish law, apostate</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Snh. X, end, 29
<sup>d</sup> משום קדשי מ' it comes under the category of dedicated sacrifices of an apostate (which cannot be offered, but are forbidden for private use). Y. Pes. VII, 34
<sup>c</sup> bot. המ' בהורייה a heretic inasmuch as he opposes the decisions of the Supreme Court (v. מַמְרֵא II). Y. Hor. III, 48
<sup>b</sup> bot. גר ומ' מ' קודם if a proselyte and a (penitent) apostate ask for charity, the apostate has the preference; a. fr.—[Y. Snh. III, 21
<sup>b</sup> top חד מ', v. הָאַסְטוּ.]—
<plural-form>Pl. מְשׁוּמָּדִים</plural-form>. R. Hash. 17
<sup>a</sup> Ms. M. (missing in ed.). Sifra Vayikra, N’dab., ch. II, Par. 2; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M02833">
<head-word>מְשׁוּמָּדוּת</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (preced.) 
<italic>apostasy</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pes. 96
<sup>a</sup> Ms. M. (ed. המרת דת), v. הֲמָרָה; Yalk. Ex. 211 משמדות פסולות (read: משומ' פוסלת).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M02834">
<head-word>מְשׁוּמְשָׁנָא</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, מְשֻׁמְּשָׁנָא
<pos> m.</pos> (שְׁמַשׁ) 
<italic>servant, attendant</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Num. XI, 28; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. מְשׁוּמְשָׁנִין, מְשֻׁמְּ'</plural-form>. Targ. I Kings X, 5 מְשׁוּמְשָׁנֹוהִי (ed. Lag. … ניה, corr. acc.).—Koh. R. to I, 3 והוה ר' אמר למשומשנוהי and Rabbi asked his waiters; Lev. R. s. 28 למְשֻׁמְּשָׁנֹוי.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M02835">
<head-word>מְשׁוּמָּת</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (denom. of שַׁמְתָּא) (
<italic>be</italic>) 
<italic>excommunicated</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 67
<sup>a</sup> (in an incantation).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M02836">
<head-word>*</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>מְשׁוּנִּית
<pos> f.</pos> (next w.) 
<italic>grotto</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Ohol. XVIII, 12, v. מְשׂוּכָּה.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M02837">
<head-word>מְשׁוּנִּיתָא</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (denom. of שִׁינָּא 
<italic>tooth</italic>) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>jaw</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Erub. 100
<sup>a</sup> דדמו כמ' (some ed. … ניתה; Ms. M. כי שִׁינִּיתָא) if the roots on the surface are shaped like a jaw-bone (Rashi: ‘rocky crag’, v. infra).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>cliff; bluff; grotto</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 10 מ' דימא וכ' the bluffs at Caesarea; (Koh. R. to XI, 1 שוניתא; ib. to V, 8 שונתא).—Taan. 23
<sup>a</sup> אהדרא ליה מ' a grotto formed around him; Midr. Till. to Ps. CXXVI. B. Mets. 108
<sup>b</sup> אפסיק מ' if a craggy mound separated the fields. Ib. 109
<sup>a</sup> אהדר ליה מ' he surrounded the fields with an embankment.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M02838">
<head-word>מַשּׁוּפִי</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (נְשַׁף) 
<italic>blowing</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yalk. Ps. 864, v. מַגְעוּרִי.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M02839">
<head-word>מְשׁוּפָּשׁ</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (transpos. of מפושפש, v. 
<xref rid="Q02090">פִּשְׁפָּשׁ</xref>; cmp. כֶּסֶךְ כַּסְכַּס.</definition>
<notes> for סכסך) 
<italic>small side-door, passage-way</italic> (v. Tam. III, 7). Zeb. 82
<sup>b</sup> דרך מ' (Ms. K. משובש) by the way of small passages in the loft (v. Midd. IV, 5 quot. s. v. לוּל). Men. 27
<sup>b</sup> דרך מ' by breaking through a side entrance (or walking in a zigzag as on winding stairs); [Rashi: = משובש, v. שָׁבַשׁ]; Yalk. Lev. 571 משופע (corr. acc.).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M02840">
<head-word>מְשׁוּקָּע</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes>, v. 
<xref rid="U01877">שָׁקַע</xref></notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M02841">
<head-word>מְשׂוּרָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>m’surah</italic>, a measure of capacity, one thirty-sixth of a Log.</definition>
<notes> Ab. ch. VI (adopted fr. Ez. V, 11). B. Mets. 61
<sup>b</sup>; B. Bath. 89
<sup>b</sup>.—Sifra K’dosh. Par. 3, ch. VIII במ' זו זיר הגדול ‘in measure’ (Lev. XIX, 35) that means you must leave a large crest (in dry measure), v. זֵיר.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M02842">
<head-word>מְשֹׁורְיָא</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (שור) 
<italic>journey</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—
<plural-form>Pl. מְשֹׁורְיָין</plural-form>. Targ. Y. I Num. XXI, 1.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M02843">
<head-word>מְשֹׁורֵר</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>singer</italic>, v. 
<xref rid="U01054">שִׁיר I</xref>.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M02844">
<head-word>מָשׁוֹשׁ</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (מוּשׁ or מָשַׁשׁ; cmp. דָּשֹׁושׁ) 
<italic>groper, slow walker</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—
<plural-form>Pl. מָשֹׁושׁוֹת</plural-form>. Y. Peah VIII, beg. 20
<sup>d</sup>, v. מוּשׁ h.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M02845">
<head-word>מְשֵׁזֵב</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes>, מְשֵׁזְבָא, etc., v. sub. מְשֵׁיז'.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M02846">
<head-word>מָשַׁח</head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>to stroke, smear;</italic> esp. 
<italic>to anoint; to install in office by anointing</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ker. 5
<sup>b</sup> מושְׁחִין את המלכים כמין נזר וכ' in anointing kings you draw the figure of a crown with the oil on your finger &c., v. כי. Ib. אין מושחין מלך וכ' a king succeeding his father is not anointed; a. v. fr.—Part. pass. מָשׁוּחַ, 
<plural-form>pl. מְשׁוּחִים, מְשׁוּחִין</plural-form>. כהן מ' a high priest installed with the ceremony of anointing, contrad. to מרובה בגדים, v. מְרוּבֶּה. Hor. III, 4; Meg. I, 9 אין כין כהן מ' בשמן וכ' there is no difference between the anointed and the unanointed high priest except &c. Sifré Tsav, Par. 3, ch. V; a. fr., v. מָשִׁיחַ.—מְשׁוּחַ מלחמה the priest anointed as the chaplain of the army. Yoma 72
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr., v. מָשִׁיחַ.—Pesik. R. s. 8 מ' מלחמה, v. מָשִׁיחַ end. Hor. 12
<sup>a</sup>, v. יָמַן. Ib. 11
<sup>b</sup> מלכי בית דוד מ' וכ' the kings of the house of David are anointed kings, those of Israel are not installed by anointment; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִמְשַׁח</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be anointed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. יהוא לא נ' וכ' Jehu would not have been anointed but for the contest of Joram’s followers. Ib. וממנו היה נִמְשָׁח המשכן וכ' with that oil (prepared by Moses) were anointed the Tabernacle &c.; 
<pgbrk id="pg851" />Y. Sot. VIII, 22
<sup>c</sup>. Num. R. s. 12 עד שנִמְשְׁחוּ כולם until all the vessels were anointed; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="M02847">
<head-word>מְשַׁח</head-word>
<language-key>ch.</language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> Targ. O. Gen. XXXI, 13. Targ. Ps. LXIV, 4 (Ms. מתח); a. fr.—Part. pass. מְשִׁיחַ. Targ. II Sam. I, 21; a. e.—Ker. 5
<sup>b</sup> ההוא דמשיח וכ' (not דמשח) that son of the high priest that was anointed was high priest &c.; Hor. 11
<sup>b</sup> אי הוה משיח וכ'.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִיתְמְשַׁח</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be rubbed with oil, perfumed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Am. VI, 6.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="M02848">
<head-word>מָשַׁח</head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to stretch, measure</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Denom. מָשׁוֹחַ, מְשִׁיחָה.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִמְשִׁיחַ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to draw the outlines</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yalk. Num. 719 עומד ומַמְשִׁיחַ בה stood there drawing (the pattern of the candlestick).</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="M02849">
<head-word>מְשַׁח</head-word>
<language-key>ch.</language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> Targ. Y. Gen. X, 25. Targ. Ez. XL, 5; a. fr.—Sabb. 19
<sup>a</sup> נִימְשַׁח וניתיב ליה נימשח ונשקול מיניה Ms. M. (ed., v. 
<xref rid="unknown">מִשְׁחָא II</xref>) let him measure when giving it out and again when receiving it back. B. Mets. 107
<sup>b</sup> לא תִימְשְׁחִינְהוּ כלל Ms. M. (ed. תימשחנו) do not measure (survey) at all.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M02850">
<head-word>מְשַׁח</head-word>
<hw-number>III</hw-number>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> מִשְׁחָא, מִישְׁ' I
<pos> m.</pos> (מְשַׁח I) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>oil, fat</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Num. VII, 13. Targ. Ex. XXIX, 7; a. fr.—Y. Maas. Sh. IV, 54
<sup>d</sup> bot. הוה ליה משח וכ' had oil which he took down to Acco (for sale). Ib. ההוא מִישְׁחָךְ וכ' (not מישחף, some ed. מישחא) that oil of thine at Beth M.—Ab. Zar. 37
<sup>a</sup> דשרו מ' who permitted oil (of gentiles). Ib. 28
<sup>a</sup> מ' דאווזא goose-fat; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>resin</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Is. XLI, 19 אעין דמ' 
<italic>pine-wood</italic> (h. text עצי שמן, v. דדנין).—Succ. 40
<sup>a</sup>, v. מִשְׁחָן. Gitt. 69
<sup>b</sup>, v. כּוּפְרָא II.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M02851">
<head-word>מְשַׁח</head-word>
<hw-number>IV</hw-number>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> מִשְׁחָא, מִי' II
<pos> m.</pos> (מְשַׁח II) 
<italic>measure, length</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. II Chr. IV, 2 חוט מ' measuring line; a. e.—[Targ. I Kings VI, 25 משחא חדא, v. מִשְׁחֲתָא.]—B. Bath. 145
<sup>b</sup> עתיר משח rich in things that are measured (corn &c.).—Sabb. 19
<sup>a</sup> במ' ניתיב וכ' let him give it out (for washing) by measure &c., v. מְשַׁח II.—V. מִשְׁחֲתָא.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M02852">
<head-word>*</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes>משחביב, Targ. Is. XXXIV, 4 ed. Lag., Ar. s. v. 
<xref rid="U00611">שחביב</xref>, absent in ed., a corrupt Massoretic gloss, perh. משתבש', v. Berl. Mass., p. 142.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M02853">
<head-word>מָשְׁחָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="M02847"> מָשַׁח I)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>official distinction, official emoluments</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Bicc. II, 64
<sup>d</sup> (ref. to Num. XVIII, 8) למ' לגדולה למ' וכ' 
<italic>l’mosh</italic>
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>a</italic> means for official distinction, for anointing (the body) &c., v. הַדְלָקָה; Zeb. 28
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. למ' לגדולה וכ' 
<italic>l’mosh</italic>
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>a</italic> means for distinction, as kings eat.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M02854">
<head-word>מִשְׁחָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> v. 
<xref rid="M02853">preced.</xref>) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>anointing, official installation</italic>; שמן המ' the oil used for installation.</definition>
<notes> Hor. III, 4; Meg. I, 9, v. מָשַׁח I. Tosef. Sot. XIII, 1 גנז … וצנצנת של שמן המ' (Josiah) removed out of sight the Ark … and the bottle of the oil of installation (made by Moses). Hor. 11
<sup>b</sup> ש' המ' … היו שולקין וכ' in the oil of installation which Moses prepared, they boiled the roots of spices. Ib. נמעול מש' המ' Ms. M. (ed. omit המ') dare we desecrate the sacred oil (by using it for non-Davidic kings)? Ib. 12
<sup>a</sup> ומי הוה ש' המ' did any oil for the installation exist (in the days of Joahaz)?; a. v. fr.—הר המ' (= b. h. הר הזיתים) 
<italic>Mount of Olives.</italic> R. Hash. II, 4; Tosef. ib. II (I), 2; a. fr.—[Sabb. 56

<sense>
<number>—2)</number>

<number>3)</number>
<definition />

<entry id="M02891">
<head-word>משַׁךְ</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="M02847"> cmp. מָשַׁח II)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to draw, pull; to seize;</italic> (with מן) 
<italic>to withdraw;</italic> in gen. 
<italic>to stretch, produce a continuous line or flow; to conduct.</italic></definition>
<notes> Kil. VIII, 2 לחרוש לִמְשׁוֹךְ ולהנהיג to plough with, to pull (by the head, go in front of), and to drive. Gen. R. s. 86 שהיו מוֹשְׁכִין וכ', v. infra. Mekh. Bo, s. 11 (ref. to Ex. XII, 2</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> מִשְׁכוּ מי שיש לו וכ' ‘lead forth’ (select), refers to him who has a lamb, ‘and buy’, refers to one who has none.</definition>
<notes> Ib. מִשְׁכוּ מע"ז withdraw from idolatry. Ib. שמוֹשְׁכִין את ידיהם ממנו וכ' that you may withdraw your share in the Passover lamb as long as it has not been slaughtered (v. מָנָה); Pes. VIII, 3. Ib. IX, 10 אלו מושכין להן אחד וכ' the one company select one lamb, the other &c.—M. Kat. I, 3 מוֹשְׁכִים את המים וכ' you may draw (conduct) the water in channels from tree to tree. Pesik. R. s. 26 שמא יִמְשׁוֹךְ לו חלב והוא אינו מוֹשֵׁךְ perhaps it (the breast) will yield him milk when sucking, but it did not yield. Ex. R. s. 52 התחילה מוֹשֶׁכֶת דינרי וכ' it (the valley) began to give forth a flow of gold denars before their eyes. Tosef. Sot. XIV, 8; Sot. 47
<sup>b</sup> מוֹשְׁכֵי הרוק those who draw out their spittle (assume aristocratic airs). Ḥag. 14
<sup>a</sup> מושכין לבו וכ' they draw the heart of the people as one conducts water, when they lecture; Sabb. 87
<sup>a</sup> (play on ויגד, Ex. XIX, 9, v. נָגַד) דברים שמושכין … כאגדה words which draw (attract) the heart of man like a lecture. Y. Ab. Zar. III, 42
<sup>c</sup> top מָשְׁכוּ צינורות דם וכ' the gutters of Laodicea carried a flow of blood; a. v. fr.—Esp. (law) 
<italic>to take possession</italic> by drawing or seizing an object, v. מְשִׁיכָה. B. Mets. IV, 2 מ' הימנו פירות וכ' if he took possession of fruits bought of him before paying. Ib. 47
<sup>a</sup> לא הספיק לִמְשׁוֹךְ וכ' he had not yet had time to take possession of the ass; a. v. fr.—Zeb. 6
<sup>b</sup> סכין מוֹשְׁכַתָּן למה שהן the slaughtering knife takes possession of them for what they are to be, i.e. the slaughtering of the sacrifices decides their purpose; Shebu. 12
<sup>b</sup>.—מ' ערלה 
<italic>to stretch the prepuce, to disguise circumcision</italic>. Y. Peah I, 16
<sup>b</sup>; a. e.—Part. pass. מָשׁוּךְ; f. מְשׁוּכָה; 
<plural-form>pl. מְשׁוּכִים, מְשׁוּכִין; מְשׁוּכוֹת</plural-form> a) 
<italic>straight-lined, continuous</italic>. Nidd. 57
<sup>b</sup> אם מ' if the blood-stain has the shape of a line, opp. עגול. Y. Erub. I, 19
<sup>b</sup> top היה מ' if the wall is straight-lined. Ib. שלא תהא הקורה מ' וכ' that the beam be not prolonged more than &c. Ib. במשוכין יותר וכ' when they are longer than &c.; a. fr.—Mikv. V, 3, v. נָדָל.—b) (with מ־) 
<italic>withdrawn</italic>. Pes. IX, 10 ידיך מ' משלך וכ' thy share be withdrawn from thy lamb, and be transferred to ours; a. e.—c) v. מָשׁוּךְ.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִמְשַׁךְ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be stretched</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Yeb. VIII, 8
<sup>d</sup> bot. נִמְשְׁכָה מאליה if the prepuce overgrew the corona of itself, v. מָשׁוּךְ.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be prolonged, continued</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Hor. 12
<sup>a</sup>. אין מושחין … כדי שׁתִּמָּשֵׁךְ מלכותן kings are anointed at a spring in order that their government may be prolonged (cmp. Ḥag. l. c.). Ib. נמשכה מלכותן their dynasty was prolonged; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be withdrawn</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Pes. VII, 7 רצו להִמָּשֵׁךְ ולהמנות וכ' (ed. Zuck. incorrect) if they desire to withdraw, and that others be entered &c. Ib. נִמְשָׁכִין והולכין וכ' they may go on withdrawing &c., a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be drawn after; to follow</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ex. R. s. 24. Gen. R. s. 86 לפרה שהיו מושכין … ולא היתה נִמְשֶׁכֶת like a cow which they attempt to pull to the slaughter-house, and which will not go; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—5)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be conducted in a channel</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Par. IX (VIII), 9 המים הנִמְשָׁכִין וכ' well-water derived into a channel &c., v. מָרַץ; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִמְשִׁיךְ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to cause to extend</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Keth. 10
<sup>b</sup> (the rain) מצדן ומַמְשִׁיךְ gives beauty and enlargement (to the fruits).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to draw, pull</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Kil. VIII, 31
<sup>c</sup> top, a. e. הנהיגה הִמְשִׁיכָהּ וכ' if he drove the animal, or pulled it, or called it. Ex. R. s. 20, beg. הִמְשַׁכְתִּיו ברסן I pulled him by the bridle; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to conduct</italic> water into channels.</definition>
<notes> Tem. 12
<sup>b</sup> שאובה שהִמְשִׁיכוּהָ כולה a collection of drawn water all of which has been conducted through a channel. Y. Shebi. II, end, 34
<sup>b</sup> להַמְשִׁיךְ to irrigate by gutters, contrad. to להשקות. Y. M. Kat. I, 80
<sup>b</sup> top ה' המעיין וכ' he led the water of a well into it. Tosef. Sabb. VII (VIII), 16 מַמְשִׁיכִין יין וכ' you may let wine or oil run in gutters before bride and groom; Ber. 50
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to prolong a meal, to add a course</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Succ. 27
<sup>a</sup>, v. פַּרְפֶּרֶת.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="M02892">

<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>

<italic>to draw, carry along</italic>.</definition>

<sup>b</sup>, a. e. מַשְׁכוּ גברי לגברא the many brought the single man over (to their opinion).</notes></sense>

<italic>to attract</italic>.</definition>

<sense>
<number>—3)</number>

<italic>to run in a continuous line; to be prolonged, continued</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. Num. XXI, 35; Ber. 54
<sup>b</sup> מַשְׁכֵי שיניה his teeth were prolonged. Hor. 12
<sup>a</sup> כי היכי דמַשְׁכוּ מיא מַשְׁכָן וכ'. as the water runs continually, so may the traditions which you teach be continued. Ib. אי משיך נהוריה (Rashi משיך) if the light continues to burn; Ker. 5
<sup>b</sup>.—[Ib. משכו שתא, read: מסיק.]—Pes. 8
<sup>a</sup> משיך נהוריה the light (of a lamp or a candle) burns steadily, opp. מיקטף איקטופי. Ab. Zar. 2
<sup>b</sup> משכי במלכותייהו they will continue their rulership; Yalk. Is. 316 משכה מלכותייהו; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to take possession</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Mets. 48
<sup>a</sup> עד דמָשֵׁיךְ until he takes possession; עד דמשך until he has taken &c. Ib. 49
<sup>a</sup> מַשְׁכֵיה he has taken possession of it; a. fr.—Meg. 31
<sup>a</sup> משך תורא ‘take possession of the ox’ (mnemotechnical words to designate the order of Scriptural readings on the Passover days, ref. to משכו, Ex. XII, 21; שור, Lev. XXII, 26 &c.).</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִימְּשִׁיךְ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be attracted, carried away, seduced</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ab. Zar. l. c. דאתי למִמְּשַׁךְ בתרייהו he may be induced to 
<pgbrk id="pg854" />follow them (the heretics). Snh. 70
<sup>a</sup> משום אִימְּשׁוּכֵי הוא it is in order to prevent being carried away (led to intemperance); לא מִימְּשִׁיךְ he will not be carried away (it has no attraction for him); Yalk. Deut. 929. Sabb. 147

<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (v. 
<xref rid="M02891">preced.</xref>

<notes> Pes. 78
<sup>b</sup> אי מִמְשְׁכֵי הני וכ' if these should withdraw (from their participation in the Passover sacrifice), it would remain fit for the others.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (denom. of מַשְׁכּוֹן) 
<italic>to take a pledge; to seize, levy</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Mets. 81
<sup>b</sup> מִשְׁכְּנוֹ בשעת הלואתו he made him give a pledge at the time when the loan was transacted; מ' שלא בשעת וכ' he seized it (through court proceedings) after the transaction of the loan. Ib. 113
<sup>b</sup> שליח ב"ד שבא למַשְׁכְּנוֹ when the court messenger comes to seize his goods. Shek. I, 3 את מי מְמַשְׁכְּנִין against whom was seizure (for the contribution of the half-Shekel) executed?—Y. ib. II, beg. 46
<sup>c</sup> מכיון שב"ד ראויין למַשְכֵּן ולא מִישְׁכְּנוּ since the court had a right to seize and did not do so (because the claim was satisfied with another man’s money). Cant. R. to I, 4 (play on משכני, ib.) מַשְׁכֵּינְנִי אחריך נרוצה execute levy against me (take my sanctuary, v. מַשְׁכּוֹן), yet after thee we run. Ex. R. s. 35 אני נוטל … ומְמַשְׁכְּנוֹ בעדם I take a righteous man from them and seize him for their guilt; a. fr.—Part. pass. מְמוּשְׁכָּן; pl. מְמוּשְׁכָּנִים, מְמוּשְׁכָּנִין. Y. Shek. l. c. אין תורמין … ולא על הממ' in distributing the Temple contributions we do not take into account that which is being collected (and has not yet come in) or that which is to be obtained by seizure. Peah VIII, 8. B. Mets. 73
<sup>b</sup>, v. next w.; a. e.</notes></sense></senses>

<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>

Ib. ויהיו מִתְמַשְׁכְּנִין וכ' and they (the righteous) will be seized &c. Num. R. s. 12 המשכן והמקדש יִתְמַשְׁכְּנוּ וכ' the Tabernacle and the Temple shall be seized &c.; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="M02913">
<head-word>מָשָׁל</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> v. 
<xref rid="M02911">מָשַׁל I</xref>) [
<italic>something tangible, substantial, plausible</italic>; cmp. אֲמַתְלָא,] 
<italic>a truth substantiated by an illustration, wise saying; fable, allegory; example; mashal</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Cant. R. introd. אל יהי המ' הזח קל וכ' do not esteem the 
<italic>mashal</italic> lightly, for through it man gets at the basis of &c. Ib. יש לו מקרא ויש לו מ' וכ', v. מְלִיצָה. Ex. R. s. 40, beg. צריך אדם לחיות נוטל מ' man should take an example (of the Lord). Pes. 49
<sup>a</sup> bot. מ' לענבי וכ' it is like mixing grapes with &c.—מ' למה הדבר דומה, v. דָּמָה a. preced.—B. Bath. 15
<sup>a</sup> איוב לא היה … אלא מ' היה the story of Job never occurred, but was invented merely as a parable. Snh. 92
<sup>b</sup> אמת מ' היה (the vision of the valley of the dead) was the truth of a 
<italic>mashal</italic>, (emended:) באמת מ' היה in the truth (the fact of resurrection) there was a symbol (for the redemption of Israel from captivity; Ez. XXXVII, 11).—Y. Keth. IV, 28
<sup>c</sup> top; Y. Snh. VIII, 26
<sup>c</sup> top זה … שנאמרו בתורה במ' this is one of the three verses in which the Law uses metaphorical expressions (Ex. XXI, 19; XXII, 2; Deut. XXII, 17); Mekh. Mishp. 6; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. מְשָׁלִים, מְשָׁלוֹת</plural-form>. Sot. IX, 15 (49
<sup>a</sup>) משמת ר"מ בטלו מושלי מ' with the death of R. M. ceased the composers of fables. Cant. R. l. c. מִשְׁלוֹתָיו של וכ' the wise sayings of Solomon. Ib. דברי מ' didactic literature, opp. זמר. Ib. שלש מ' three collections of sayings (Prov. I to IX; X to XXIV; XXV to XXXI). Num. R. s. 14, end ועם בלעם … כי אם במ' God spoke to Balaam only through allegories (visions).—Succ. 28
<sup>a</sup> מִשְׁלוֹת שועלין (Ms. M. מִמְשְׁלוֹת, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) fox-fables; מ' כובסין washers’ fables; B. Bath. 134
<sup>a</sup>. Snh. 38
<sup>b</sup> (Ms. M. ממשלת); Yalk. Prov. 947.—Gitt. 35
<sup>a</sup> bot. ספר איוב ומִמְשָׁלוֹת copies of the Books of Job and 
<italic>Proverbs</italic> (v. infra).—מִשְׁלֵי (sub. שלמה) 
<italic>Mishlé, the Book of Proverbs</italic> (commencing with the word 
<italic>mishlé</italic>). Cant. R. l. c. B. Bath. 14
<sup>b</sup>. Y. Yoma I, end, 39
<sup>b</sup>; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>
